description: This file defines the MetricRepository interface, which extends MongoRepository, and provides methods for querying performance metrics from a MongoDB database based on various criteria such as employee ID, metric type, and timestamp ranges.

classes.name: MetricRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for accessing PerformanceMetric data in MongoDB, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByEmployeeId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PerformanceMetric objects for a specific employee ID.

methods.name: findByEmployeeIdAndMetricType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PerformanceMetric objects for a specific employee ID and metric type.

methods.name: findByEmployeeIdAndMetricTypeAndTimestampBetween
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PerformanceMetric objects for a specific employee ID, metric type, and timestamp range.

methods.name: findByTimestampBetween
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PerformanceMetric objects within a specified timestamp range.
